newsitem.title: USA: Stone sets $101 mln development budget.
newsitem.headline: Stone sets $101 mln development budget.

text.p: Stone Energy Corp on Thursday said it budgeted $101 million for the development of its oil and gas properties in 1997.

That compares with about $55 million spent on development and $21 million invested in acquisitions in 1996, the company's chief financial officer, Michael Finch, said at a New York Society of Security Analysts meeting.
The company also plans to drill 24 new wells in 1997 and recomplete 21 existing wells to boost production, it said. The company plans to install three new offshore production platforms.
The higher spending in 1997 reflects an increased property base resulting from acquisitions last year, Stone Energy said.
